direct_official_checks: OSTN15 is the definitive ETRS89 to OSGB36 transformation
OSTN15 uses a grid of easting and northing shifts
transformation grid resolution is one kilometre
point shifts are obtained by bilinear interpolation
simple Helmert transformation is limited to about 3m applications
GNSS plus OSTN15 defines modern National Grid access
horizontal transformation error is distinct from terrain-height error
quality_effect: Separates horizontal CRS-transformation uncertainty from terrain-surface uncertainty.
